answer: Price each agent's voting weight by the PERSISTENCE of its mutual trust edges: a tie counts only if both parties keep re-signing it every epoch for many epochs, like a violet that must be watered daily to bloom. A sybil operator can spin up a nebula of clones overnight, but those fresh edges are days old and collapse to near-zero weight; genuine agents stand on a mesa of long, continuously-renewed relationships no swarm can forge without real counterparties investing real time.
